quarterly_data.quarter: Fenghua Advanced Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (half-year report): revenue RMB 3,499,796,818.88, +26.28% year on year; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 290,300,156.58, +74.01%; excluding non-recurring items RMB 287,606,531.21, +68.84%. Q2 net profit attributable and excluding non-recurring items rose 127.80% and 126.60% from Q1. The company cites the electronic-components upcycle, higher year-on-year unit prices of its main products and record revenue, output and sales volume.

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and supply (half-year report): RMB 172,250,055.24 of Xianghe Industrial Park high-end capacitor base equipment moved into fixed assets in H1 2026 as it reached usable state, cutting construction in progress to RMB 72,804,685.53; 98.56% of the RMB 5,271,814,555.82 budget was invested; the May 21, 2026 shareholders' meeting approved closing the Xianghe raised-fund project. quarterly_data.quarter: Fenghua Advanced Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company statement (half-year report risk section): its capacity scale and technology still trail leading international peers, and it will compete with them directly as it moves up-market; precious-metal and other raw-material costs are a pressure. Rising metal raw-material prices and tighter upstream settlement terms raised material purchases, cutting operating cash flow to RMB 161,104,524.00 (-55.64%).
